text:
marta: FYI Acme Payments customer reporting function-call args arrive as partial JSON across SSE reconnects; schema validation fails.

support-bot: Created INC-4721, routed to support-oncall.

josh: Can you paste raw chunks and SDK/version?

marta: Node SDK v2.1.4, SSE chunked transfer. Customer logs show chunks split inside quoted strings.

```
chunk A: {"order_id":"ord_9876","items":[{"sku":"X123","qty":2}],"shipping":{"name":"Anne 
chunk B: "O'Connor","addr":"12 River Rd\nApt 4"},"billing":{"method":"card","last4":"4242"}}
```

marta: Their client logs show connection reset between those receives; second stream is treated as a new message so the parser sees tokens out of order.

dan: Likely vector: acme-proxy splitting chunk mid-quote. Response headers show: Via: 1.1 acme-proxy; Transfer-Encoding: chunked.

priya: Do their clients attempt to reattach/concatenate fragments across reconnects? If not, fragments are effectively orphaned.

marta: They auto-reconnect; their app relies on SDK 'data' events and didn't implement cross-connection reassembly. Example from client:

[client] recv: "...\"name\": \"Anne
[client] connection reset
[client] new SSE established
[client] recv: "O'Connor\", \"addr\": ... }

josh: Our node-sdk currently emits each SSE 'data' event; no built-in logic to merge fragments from separate connections.

marta: Correct — SDK doesn't reassemble across reconnects.

dan: Short-term mitigation options: (A) ask customer to set stream=false for function args (arrives as one payload but breaks streaming UX), (B) quick SDK patch to buffer SSE chunks for probable toolcall payloads until valid JSON emerges, (C) server-side guard to avoid flushing partial toolcall frames.

priya: Recommend combining SDK buffer + runtime guard. SDK patch is fastest for node users; runtime change will protect all clients.

marta: I pushed a minimal buffer in node-sdk to try JSON.parse on buffered data and only emit when valid: https://github.com/redwood/node-sdk/pull/412

eng-runtime: We're triaging now. Hypothesis: serializer does flush serialized segments too early; implement per-request reassembly server-side and a small parser to detect balanced braces and safe boundaries (not inside quoted strings).

sre-bot: Capturing tcpdump/proxy logs for the customer IP range; retention set to 72h.

priya: Add CI + integration tests simulating mid-string chunk boundaries with reconnects and assert final reconstructed payload passes function schema validation.

marta: Customer accepted stream=false temporarily but wants ETA for runtime fix. Eng-runtime: can you post ETA in INC-4721?

eng-runtime: If the change is straightforward we'll ship a hotfix to hosted runtime within ~72 hours. If proxy tuning is needed we'll coordinate with SRE and may need slightly more time.

marta: Ticket escalated. I'll attach repro, logs, and the SDK workaround. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket remains open until runtime confirms hotfix.
